summary: Frontend-only testing for Layout Configurator room properties: wall thickness editing and dimension visibility toggles. All 4 features tested successfully.

issues: Console shows repeated 'alphabetical' is not valid CanvasTextBaseline enum - fabric.js compatibility warning (non-blocking)

features_tested.feature: Wall thickness fields in Properties panel (Feature 1)
features_tested.details: When a room is selected, the Properties panel shows 'Grubość ścian (cm)' section with 4 editable fields: Lewa (Left), Prawa (Right), Górna (Top), Dolna (Bottom). All fields display default value 4.4 cm and are editable.
Properties panel shows 'Widoczność wymiarów' section with two Switch toggles: 'zewn. (zewnętrzne)' for outer dimensions and 'wewn. (wewnętrzne)' for inner dimensions. Both are ON by default.
Room dimension labels on canvas show 'zewn:' prefix instead of 'внеш:' and 'wewn:' prefix instead of 'внутр:'. Verified labels: 'zewn: 200.7 cm' and 'wewn: 191.9 cm' displayed on room.
Changed 'Lewa' wall thickness from 4.4 to 4.410 cm in Properties panel. The updateDimensionLabels() function is called on change, and labels update accordingly on canvas.

code_review_findings.lines_4034_4120: Properties panel correctly displays 'Grubość ścian (cm)' section with 4 input fields for wall thicknesses (Lewa, Prawa, Górna, Dolna) when selectedObject.isRoomGroup is true
code_review_findings.lines_4124_4157: 'Widoczność wymiarów' section with two Switch components for 'zewn. (zewnętrzne)' and 'wewn. (wewnętrzne)' toggles. Each toggle calls updateDimensionLabels() on change.
code_review_findings.lines_1635_1692: updateDimensionLabels() correctly uses Polish labels: 'zewn: ${outerWidthCm} cm' and 'wewn: ${innerWidthCm} cm' for room dimension labels on canvas.

critical_code_review_comments: All requested features are correctly implemented in the code
Polish labels (zewn/wewn) properly replace Russian labels (внеш/внутр)
Wall thickness fields correctly update room dimensions via updateDimensionLabels()
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout Configurator room properties testing completed successfully. All 4 features work as expected: 1) Wall thickness editing (Grubość ścian section with Lewa/Prawa/Górna/Dolna fields), 2) Dimension visibility toggles (zewn./wewn. switches), 3) Polish labels on canvas (zewn:/wewn: prefixes), 4) Labels update when wall thickness changes. Path: Login -> Panel administracyjny -> Планировки tab -> Click 'Комната' button -> Add room -> Click on room to see properties.
